Company Overview

 Position Title
 Automated Tester 
 Role Overview
 We are seeking an enthusiastic and proactive Automated Tester to join our team. This internship offers a unique opportunity to work directly in a production environment, collaborating with other developers to enhance our platform's testing systems. The ideal candidate will be passionate about contributing to impactful projects.

 Responsibilities: 

• Architecting the complete testing mechanism with a proper plan.

• Create, maintain, and execute automated test cases using tools like BugBug , GetScandium , and/or similar low-code/no-code testing platforms.

• Identify, document, and track defects, collaborating with developers for resolution.

• Maintain accurate and detailed automated testing documentation, including test plans, scripts, and reports.

• Find edge cases and improve test coverage. (End-to-end responsibility from test planning to implementation and deployment)

• Regularly update the client and internal teams on test progress, findings, and automation improvements.

• Incorporate feedback into automated test workflows and enhance coverage over time.

 Requirements:

• Experience or strong interest in automated testing using low-code/no-code platforms (BugBug, GetScandium, TestSigma, etc.).

• Good understanding of JavaScript and HTML for creating advanced automation scripts and troubleshooting (Optional)

• Strong attention to detail, ensuring automated scripts accurately reflect client requirements before Go Live.

• Excellent written and verbal English for clear communication and documentation.

• Ability and willingness to learn quickly, especially in the domain of impact measurement and the charity sector.

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies, regression testing, and CI/CD integration for automated tests is a plus.

• 
 Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.

 PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS A FIXED-TERM CONTRACT, AND THE COMPENSATION IS GOAL-BASED / PERFORMANCE-BASED, PAID IN LUMP-SUM AT THE END OF THE TENURE.
